$comment: Adult Coco, the closed-eyed sage with the sun and lightning (blender/sculpt/meshy-cloud-monkey-sage.glb). Read by blender/scripts/build_coco_sage.py (and, for the face landmarks, by character_prep.py's helpers). Blender axes, metres: +X his left, -Y towards you, +Z up. Landmarks, face ellipse and joints were measured on gridded orthographic renders of the full-res sculpt (face at 0.375 mm per pixel) and checked again on the web copy.

web.$comment: Simplification. He is simplified region by region, each region to its own triangle budget and by shape alone inside it, the others locked meanwhile; the rest of him (fur, robe, hat) gets what is left of 'tris'; triangles straddling two regions ('borders' in the log) come out of it too. The skin (hands, feet, ears) has its own budget because it is smooth, so coarse triangles show there as facets. The fur is three quarters of the sculpt: budgeted this way it keeps its sculpted tufts on HiDPI screens (he is about 700 device px tall at a device pixel ratio of 1.75). faceRegion: the face ellipse scaled up a little and 'depth' metres behind 'front', so the seam's surroundings match the face. keepGem: the third eye (out to this multiple of its ellipse) is never simplified: it is a small UV island, and collapsing across its outline tore its painted corner. strayPaint: after simplifying, a triangle whose paint is further than this (RGB distance, 0-1.7) from the sculpt's own colours on the same spot takes its UVs from the sculpt again. 'factor' only locks the other regions.

landmarks3d.$comment: the same landmarks with their depth (y) from ray casts on the full-res sculpt. A = his right (viewer's left).

gem.$comment: the cyan third eye: it has cloud colours, so it is excluded from every cloud selection, and every face shape moves it as one piece

thirdEye.$comment: the gem's cyan triangles (inside 'reach' of the gem ellipse) get their own material 'third_eye': the same texture plus a small emission (the guide contract's optional material), so the site can raise its glow

bones.$comment: the hand-built rig: [head, tail, parent]. Bones run along the limbs; build_coco_sage.py sets each roll so local X is the main bend axis. Leg bones mark the crossed legs (feet in front, soles up) and carry no weights: his legs, the held cloud and the swirls fused to them are fused together in the sculpt, so they stay rigid (legs and swirls on root, the held cloud on 'cloud'). 'cloud' holds the cloud in his hands; 'swirl_head' is the loose swirl beside his hat (its head and tail come from the mesh).
head: neck

regions.$comment: how the build sorts his surface for skinning. Cloud colour: hue 160-215 with saturation > 0.18 and value > 0.35, or near-white (s < 0.18, v > 0.75, b >= r - 0.02). The held cloud is the cloud piece inside heldBox; pieces whose middle is below staticBelowZ are the swirls fused to his legs and feet (rigid on root); smaller pieces higher up (on his right upper arm, the shoulder wisp, the turquoise bits by the pendant) ride rigidly with the fur they touch.

earZone.$comment: ears and earrings follow the head

headPlane.$comment: head/neck boundary, lower at the front so the beard goes with the chin: z = z0 + slope * (y + 0.35), blended over +-band

limbRadius.$comment: metres from the bone: a limb owns what is inside the first radius, the torso what is outside the second

torsoBands.$comment: z ranges (metres) where one torso bone hands over to the next, and where the outer top of the chest goes to the shoulders (distance from his centre line, height)

shapes.$comment: Face shapes. 'keep' are character_prep's standard shapes that make sense with closed eyes (grin, jawOpen and mouthO are left out: his lip line is painted and there is no mouth inside). The closed-eye life shapes are sized for the Home page, where he is about 400 px tall (1 px is about 4.8 mm): each moves its feature 1.5-3 px at full weight.

sun.$comment: sun_bolt keeps his colours and glows softly: its own material with the base colour also used as emission

breath.$comment: breathe: 5.0 s loop (150 frames). Inhale 40%, exhale 52%, rest 8%. Degrees (local; negative chest = the ribcage lifts), millimetres; lag in frames after the belly (the belly leads, the chest follows, the shoulders come last, the head trails). The lower spine gives a little as the ribcage lifts and the neck levels the head, so his head stays steady (it rides about 1.5 mm) while his chest and shoulders rise.
